core_obligations: Apply Noether normalization to the generic fibre to get elements of the source over which it is finite and injective (proof lines 28354-28362).

Clear the finitely many denominators appearing in the integrality relations to build the intermediate algebra and find one nonzero element of the base after which the two algebras agree (proof lines 28362-28377).
proof_roadmap: Clear denominators to get the intermediate algebra and the isomorphism after inverting f (proof lines 28362-28378).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an injective finite type map over a domain factors through a polynomial algebra over which the next algebra is finite, up to inverting one nonzero element of the base (statement lines 28342-28351). The proof normalizes the generic fibre, then clears the finitely many denominators in the integrality relations to produce the intermediate algebra and a single element of the base after which the factorisation becomes an isomorphism (proof lines 28353-28378). Clearing denominators uniformly so that one element suffices is the step that carries the argument. H2.
